description: Road-trip weather along a route — Weather for a US drive: samples up to 8 points along the path from from= to to= (place names or lat,lon), estimates when you reach each one (speed_mph=, default 55; depart= ISO time, default now) and reads the NWS hourly forecast and active alerts at that ETA. Flags snow, ice, freezing rain, thunderstorms, heavy rain, fog and high wind; verdict CLEAR / CAUTION / HAZARDOUS; also scores departing 3 hours earlier up to 24 hours later and suggests a better departure time. Example: /v1/weather/route?from=Nashville, TN&to=Chicago, IL Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_route
